capabilities.purpose: Let a learner choose the one correct option from a closed set.
capabilities.cognitive_job: discriminate the correct idea from plausible alternatives
capabilities.choose_when: The response reduces to one option, and every wrong option is one a real learner would pick for a stateable reason.
capabilities.reject_when: Distractors are filler, more than one option is defensible, or the answer cannot be reduced to a selection.
prerequisites: The idea being checked has already been taught in this lesson.

capabilities.purpose: Let a learner choose every option that satisfies the prompt.
capabilities.cognitive_job: apply a membership rule across several candidates
capabilities.choose_when: More than one option is correct and the learner must find all of them without being told how many.
capabilities.reject_when: Exactly one option is correct, or the options are not independent of each other.
prerequisites: The membership rule has been stated or derived in this lesson.

capabilities.purpose: Have a learner supply the missing terms inside a given structure.
capabilities.choose_when: The surrounding text supplies enough context that the missing term is determinate, and the accepted answers can be enumerated.
capabilities.reject_when: The answer is a judgement, a sentence, or has more valid phrasings than can be listed.
prerequisites: The terms being recalled appear earlier in the lesson.

capabilities.purpose: Collect a numeric answer and score it within a declared tolerance.
capabilities.cognitive_job: carry out a calculation and report a value
capabilities.choose_when: The answer is a single number, and the acceptable spread around it can be stated as a tolerance.
capabilities.reject_when: The answer is a range, a symbolic expression, or depends on the method the learner chose.
prerequisites: The method producing the value has been demonstrated or derived.

capabilities.purpose: Collect a short written answer, scored against declared accepted answers or read by a teacher.
capabilities.cognitive_job: produce an answer in the learner’s own words
capabilities.choose_when: The learner must write the answer. Use accepted-answers only when the correct wordings can genuinely be listed; otherwise use teacher-review.
capabilities.reject_when: The answer is open reasoning and the author wants it auto-scored anyway. String matching is not comprehension.
prerequisites: A teacher review surface exists when evaluation is teacher-review.

capabilities.purpose: Have a learner connect each item to its counterpart.
capabilities.choose_when: Each item has exactly one counterpart, and the correspondence is the thing being learned.
capabilities.reject_when: An item has several valid counterparts, or the sets are so small the answer is obvious by elimination.
prerequisites: Both sides have been introduced in the lesson.

capabilities.purpose: Have a learner assign each item to exactly one named category.
capabilities.choose_when: Every item belongs to exactly one category and the membership rule has been stated.
capabilities.reject_when: An item legitimately belongs to more than one category. Multiple-category membership is not implemented, so it must not be authored.
prerequisites: The categories and their membership rule appear in the lesson.

capabilities.purpose: Let a learner reconstruct a defensible order.
capabilities.choose_when: The stages have one defensible order and every stage is distinguishable from the others.
capabilities.reject_when: Several orders are valid. Only one accepted order is implemented, so alternatives must not be claimed.
prerequisites: The process has been shown or traced in the lesson.
